resources.string: Horizon Mobile
Link your PC
On your PC, open Horizon › Settings › Plugins, turn on Phone, then show the code.
Your phone and your PC must be on the same Wi-Fi. Nothing goes through the Internet.
Scan the code
Point at the code shown by Horizon
Without the camera, the app cannot read the code. Allow it in the phone settings.
Open settings
Try again
This code is not from Horizon.
This Horizon code is incomplete. Show a new one.
Update Horizon or the app: they do not speak the same version.
Link this PC?
A link asks to link your phone to “%1$s” (%2$s, port %3$d). Accept only if you have just opened the code shown by your own Horizon. A PC that is already linked will be replaced.
Link
Cancel
Connecting to the PC…
PC not found. Check that the phone is on the same Wi-Fi.
This code has expired. Show a new one in Horizon.
This code was already used. Show a new one in Horizon.
The PC refused this code. Show a new one in Horizon.
Another machine answers at this PC\'s address. Show a new code in Horizon.
Linked to %1$s
When should the link be kept?
All the time (recommended)
The bar follows your battery even when the app is closed, with a discreet notification.
Only while the app is open
Nothing runs in the background; the bar is only up to date when you open the app.
